def split_list_items(s):
    items = []
    cur = []
    in_quotes = False
    for ch in s:
        if ch == '"':
            in_quotes = not in_quotes
            cur.append(ch)
        elif ch == "," and not in_quotes:
            items.append("".join(cur))
            cur = []

            cur.append(ch)
    items.append("".join(cur))
    return items

def parse_token(token):
    if token is None:
        return None
    t = str(token).strip()
    if t.endswith(";"):
        t = t[:-1].strip()
    if len(t) >= 2 and t[0] == '"' and t[-1] == '"':
        return t[1:-1]
    if re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?\d+", t):
        return int(t)
    if re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?(?:\d+\.\d*|\.\d+)", t):
        return float(t)
    return t

def parse_filter(filter_text):
    result = {}
    if filter_text is None:
        return result
    text = str(filter_text)

    list_pattern = re.compile(r'\(\s*"([^"]+)"\s+IN\s+LIST\s+([^)]+?)\s*\)', re.IGNORECASE)
    for field, values_text in list_pattern.findall(text):
        values = [parse_token(item) for item in split_list_items(values_text)]
        result[field] = values if values else [None]

    eq_pattern = re.compile(r'\(\s*"([^"]+)"\s*=\s*("([^"]*)"|[^)]+?)\s*\)', re.IGNORECASE)
    for match in eq_pattern.finditer(text):
        field = match.group(1)
        raw_value = match.group(2)
        result[field] = [parse_token(raw_value)]

    return result

ws_in = wb["Input"]
ws_out = wb["Output"]

input_headers = {}
for cell in ws_in[1]:
    if cell.value is not None:
        input_headers[str(cell.value)] = cell.column

output_headers = ["wtype_id", "name", "status", "orgId", "careType", "specialtyId", "contextId"]

    name = ws_in.cell(row_idx, input_headers["name"]).value

    if wtype_id is None and name is None and status is None and filter_text is None:

from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.utils import range_boundaries
from pathlib import Path
from itertools import product
import re

spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/325-44/1_325-44_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/325-44_0_817c53e9/1_325-44_output.xlsx"

def split_list_items(s):
    items = []
    cur = []
    in_quotes = False
    i = 0
    while i < len(s):
        ch = s[i]
        if ch == '"':
            in_quotes = not in_quotes
            cur.append(ch)
        elif ch == "," and not in_quotes:
            items.append("".join(cur))
            cur = []
        else:
            cur.append(ch)
        i += 1
    items.append("".join(cur))
    return items

def parse_token(token):
    if token is None:
        return None
    t = str(token).strip()
    if t.endswith(";"):
        t = t[:-1].strip()
    if len(t) >= 2 and t[0] == '"' and t[-1] == '"':
        return t[1:-1]
    if re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?\d+", t):
        return int(t)
    if re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?(?:\d+\.\d*|\.\d+)", t):
        return float(t)
    return t

def parse_filter(filter_text):
    result = {}
    if filter_text is None:
        return result
    text = str(filter_text)

    # Parse IN LIST clauses first
    list_pat = re.compile(r'\(\s*"([^"]+)"\s+IN\s+LIST\s+([^)]+?)\s*\)', re.IGNORECASE)
    for field, values_text in list_pat.findall(text):
        vals = [parse_token(item) for item in split_list_items(values_text)]
        result[field] = vals if vals else [None]

    # Parse equality clauses
    eq_pat = re.compile(r'\(\s*"([^"]+)"\s*=\s*("([^"]*)"|[^)]+?)\s*\)', re.IGNORECASE)
    for match in eq_pat.finditer(text):
        field = match.group(1)
        raw_val = match.group(2)
        result[field] = [parse_token(raw_val)]

    return result

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws_in = wb["Input"]
ws_out = wb["Output"] if "Output" in wb.sheetnames else wb.create_sheet("Output")

input_headers = {}
for cell in ws_in[1]:
    if cell.value is not None:
        input_headers[str(cell.value)] = cell.column

required_input_cols = ["wtype_id", "name", "status", "filter"]
for col in required_input_cols:
    if col not in input_headers:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing required input column: {col}")

output_headers = ["wtype_id", "name", "status", "orgId", "careType", "specialtyId", "contextId"]
filter_fields = output_headers[3:]

rows_out = [output_headers]

for r in range(2, ws_in.max_row + 1):
    base_vals = [
        ws_in.cell(r, input_headers["wtype_id"]).value,
        ws_in.cell(r, input_headers["name"]).value,
        ws_in.cell(r, input_headers["status"]).value,
    ]
    filter_val = ws_in.cell(r, input_headers["filter"]).value

    # Skip completely blank source rows
    if all(v is None for v in base_vals) and filter_val is None:
        continue

    parsed = parse_filter(filter_val)
    value_lists = []
    for fld in filter_fields:
        vals = parsed.get(fld, [None])
        if not vals:
            vals = [None]
        value_lists.append(vals)

    for combo in product(*value_lists):
        rows_out.append(base_vals + list(combo))

# Only modify the allowed answer range
answer_range = "A1:G10"
min_col, min_row, max_col, max_row = range_boundaries(answer_range)
max_rows_allowed = max_row - min_row + 1
max_cols_allowed = max_col - min_col + 1

# Clear/rebuild the output answer area from the computed split data
for rr in range(min_row, max_row + 1):
    for cc in range(min_col, max_col + 1):
        ws_out.cell(rr, cc).value = None

for i, row_vals in enumerate(rows_out[:max_rows_allowed], start=min_row):
    for j, val in enumerate(row_vals[:max_cols_allowed], start=min_col):
        ws_out.cell(i, j).value = val

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
